Alex: Heads up — I'm out for PTO starting tomorrow through Monday morning. There's a coverage gap overnight Sat+Sun 00:00-08:00 UTC. My default secondary is @Ria but she's APAC and might be asleep for part of that window. Can someone volunteer to be primary for either night? If nobody volunteers I can try to remote-cover but I'd prefer a local-ish handoff for faster retries on P0s. Runbook here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-paging — see section 'Weekend last-minute fill-in'.

oncall-bot: Reminder: current rota shows Alex as primary Fri 16:00 UTC -> Mon 08:00 UTC. Paging rules: P0 -> primary + phone, P1 -> primary only, P2 -> triage in morning. Escalation policy & contact list: https://redwood.internal/policies/pagerduty. To claim shift: `/claim-oncall 2026-03-14-night`

Ria: I can take primary for Sat 00:00-08:00 UTC (my evening). I can also be available for quick triage on Sun if Matt needs help. Two notes: 1) If there's a redis OOM pattern, runbook step 4.1 says to roll back last deploy and increase cache ttl. 2) If alerts flood, prefer muting noisy non-actionable alerts before paging site owners.

Matt: I can cover Sun 00:00-08:00 UTC. Confirming I will claim the shift via the bot now. I'll be primary for Sun and secondary for Sat (in case Ria needs escalation). Can someone paste the exact emergency runbook snippet for incidents that require DB failover? I don't want to search during a page.

Elaine: Quick copy for DB failover (from runbook):
```
- Notify SRE and DB on-call
- Pause all writes via feature-flag `writes.pause=true`
- Promote standby (pg_ctl promote) and monitor replication lag < 100ms
- Reconcile and resync replicas after primary is healthy
```
Also: if latency spike looks like batching overload, try toggling batching.mode=conservative via the runtime config and reduce max_batch_tokens to 512. That usually keeps tail latencies stable without full rollback.

Ria: Thanks Elaine — saved. Matt — if you get paged for DB failover ping me in thread and I'll DM the DB on-call directly.

Matt: Claimed shift via bot: `/claim-oncall 2026-03-15-night` — bot confirms. I'm adding calendar blocks. Can Alex drop a short handoff note with any ongoing mitigations or experiments that might trigger alerts?

Alex: Posted a quick handoff: 1) We have a canary rollout to 3% for fastgen-model-2 that increases token churn; watch errors 5xx and memory spikes (see deployment id: deploy-3307). 2) There was a minor KV cache eviction pattern yesterday — I increased ttl to 30m, but watch for renewed evictions. 3) No active incidents. If P0 page arrives: follow runbook top-level checklist, escalate to Elaine (SRE lead) if unable to re-establish primary within 15m.

oncall-bot: Shift assignment update: Sat 00:00-08:00 UTC -> Ria (primary), Sun 00:00-08:00 UTC -> Matt (primary). Alex -> handoff notes attached. All set.

Elaine: One more operational tip: if you get repeated paging noise from infra-alerts, set temporary filter by running:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://alerts.internal/filters" -d '{"service":"infra","reason":"noise","duration":600}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ONCALL_TOKEN"
```
Runbook link again for quick reference: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-paging#weekend-fill-ins

Alex: Really appreciate the cover. Ria/Matt — please ping here when you take on-call (reply with ack) and update the incident channel if you get a P0. Keeping thread for any live handoff notes. :wave:
